dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-back toward both the anterior and posterior regions; posterior-most peduncle region is obscured by surface splash.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear smooth and symmetrical with no visible bulges or indentations along the water-skin interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey skin tone with a uniform reflectance across the dorsal surface, exhibiting a slight blue-lavender tint.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced, well-defined dorsal ridge (crest) appearing as a sharp longitudinal feature along the central axis.
